workflowDef.name: SDLC Playbook
workflowDef.description: AI-native SDLC loop: the request is captured verbatim as intent.md and accepted by the product owner; one spec author turns it into spec.md under the org's policy skills and the product owner signs off; a dev writes plan.md before any code and an engineer approves it; implementation is reviewed against the plan; QA, CI, then the PR. Every stage commits its artifact to the feature branch. Every gate is a human.

reviewGates.name: Intent Acceptance
reviewGates.instructions: Created by the hub at intake (not by you): the Intent Acceptance ticket already exists and your own ticket is blocked by it.

reviewGates.name: Plan Approval
reviewGates.instructions: After the 'Plan:' ticket ONLY (not the implementation tickets): create a "Plan Approval" ticket assigned to "human:engineer", blocked_by the Plan ticket. Every implementation, review, QA and CI ticket must be blocked_by this gate (directly or through the chain).
